questions.question: What actually happens at a first visit?
questions.answer: About an hour. We measure weight, waist, BMI, blood pressure and blood sugar, and talk through what you eat in a normal week. A nutritionist explains every reading. You leave with your numbers written down and a clear recommendation including, honestly, whether you need a programme at all.

questions.question: Do I have to come to the clinic in Kigali?
questions.answer: The first visit is in the clinic in Kicukiro — Niboye, same building as Chancen International, because the measurements have to be taken properly. Follow-up reviews can be done by phone or video if travelling is hard, and the app carries your plan between visits.

questions.question: Is this covered by my insurance?
questions.answer: Not automatically. We are talking to insurers about preventive benefits, and if your employer has a Vitaway programme, your health check may already be paid for. Ask us and we will tell you straight.

questions.question: Will you just tell me to stop eating the food I like?
questions.answer: No. A plan that removes everything you enjoy lasts about nine days. We build on what you already buy at the market and already cook, and change the things that move the numbers most.

questions.question: Do I need to be ill to come?
questions.answer: No — and most people who benefit most are not ill yet. Nearly nine in ten Rwandan adults have never had their blood sugar measured. Coming before something is wrong is the entire point.

questions.question: Where is the clinic?
questions.answer: CPR-Unit House, 1st Floor, KK21 Ave, Niboye, Kicukiro, Kigali — same building as Chancen International.

questions.question: Who is eligible for Vitaway for Prevention, Hypertension, or Diabetes?
questions.answer: Vitaway is personalised to support people as their needs evolve—whether you have overweight or obesity, and are at risk for or living with ongoing health conditions. This includes people living with prediabetes, diabetes, hypertension, high cholesterol, anxiety, and depression. Please speak to your human resources department to find out what conditions are covered under your plan or contact: info@vitaway.org

questions.question: What’s included with Vitaway for Prevention, Hypertension, or Diabetes?
questions.answer:
The program surrounds you with a variety of tools and support tailored to what you need to succeed. You can expect:
● A professional health coach for one-on-one support
● Syncable devices to track your metrics (scale, blood pressure monitor, glucose meter)
● Weekly interactive lessons focused on physical, social, and psychological wellness
● A supportive online community of peers

questions.question: How are the Prevention, Diabetes, and Hypertension programs structured?
questions.answer: Vitaway introduces a new area of focus biweekly, such as nutrition habits, physical activity, blood pressure monitoring, stress management, and insulin use. Each topic is supported by lessons, coaching, and community features. Coaches personalize your experience by focusing on your specific goals and areas of improvement.

questions.question: Do you offer services for workplaces?
questions.answer: Yes. We provide wellness programmes for companies, employees, schools, and organisations — tailored to their needs.

questions.question: What is Vitaway Plus?
questions.answer: It’s our mobile app that carries your plan, appointments, and measurements between visits — so week seven is not a guess, and your nutritionist can see what actually happened.

questions.question: Do I need to pay to use the app?
questions.answer: Basic access is available in the app. For coaching, reports, and personalised meal planning, contact info@vitaway.org.

questions.question: Can I use the app without visiting your clinic?
questions.answer: Yes. The app is fully functional for remote clients. Virtual consultations and chat support are available. The first measurement visit is still in clinic.

questions.question: Do you have health packages?
questions.answer: Yes. We offer monthly and annual packages for individuals, families, and organisations. These include consultations, meal plans, tracking, and exclusive content.

questions.question: Are there discounts for groups or companies?
questions.answer: Yes. We run programmes for companies and families — contact info@vitaway.org to discuss what fits.

questions.question: Can I customise my own package?
questions.answer: Absolutely. Health is personal, and you can tailor your package based on your goals — weight loss, diabetes care, and more.

questions.question: Do you sell nutrition products and wellness items?
questions.answer: Yes. Our shop offers a curated selection of nutritional supplements, healthy snacks, wellness kits, and educational materials recommended by our experts.

questions.question: How do I place an order?
questions.answer: Visit www.vitaway.org/shop to browse and purchase directly. You can also order through the Vitaway+ app.

questions.question: Do you deliver orders?
questions.answer: Yes. We offer delivery services within Kigali and nearby districts. More delivery locations will be added soon.

questions.question: Can I buy without an appointment?
questions.answer: Absolutely. The shop is open to the public — no consultation is needed to place an order.

questions.question: Are your products safe and approved?
questions.answer: All products are reviewed by licensed nutritionists and comply with the Rwanda FDA and safety regulations.
